theorem_natural_language_statement: For every positive rational $r$ strictly above all twelve costs of the fixed expansion-232 quartic parameter choice, deterministic integer 3SUM satisfies the campaign's exact shared word-RAM specification in $O(n^r)$ time. The theorem must construct a finite program for each fixed integer-size exponent, preserve distinct input positions and repetitions, reject sizes below three, and establish correctness for every sufficiently large word width together with instruction, addressing and memory costs. No solver oracle or assumed program-correctness contract is a hypothesis. This is the remaining algorithmic extension sought by this mission: the source package explicitly leaves it unproved.
